local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local points={{util.vector3(-1600.6,609.1,6524),util.vector3(-1162.4,599.3,6524),util.vector3(-1009.6,347.3,6542)}}
local step=1
local frames=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frames=frames+1
 assert(Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current>0,'Player died in final sewers')
 if frames==5 then print('Final sewer traversal ready') end
 if step<=#points then
  local d=points[step]-self.position
  if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<25 then
   print('Final sewer waypoint '..step..' reached') step=step+1
  else
   local c=camera.getPosition()
   local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(util.vector3(c.x+d.x,c.y+d.y,c.z))
   local angle=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z)
   print(string.format('Final sewer waypoint %d aim x=%d y=%d',step,math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(angle*5120+.5))),math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*5120+.5)))
  end
 end
 if frames%5==0 then
  print('Final sewer pos '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
  for _,id in ipairs({{0x666a7,0x66a02,0x66a03,0x66a04,0x666da}}) do
   local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
   if obj and obj:isValid() then print('Final sewer creature '..id..' pos='..tostring(obj.position)..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(obj))..' hp='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(obj).current) end
  end
 end
end}}}}
